title: 2004 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Stéphane Peterhansel / Jean-Paul Cottret (Mitsubishi) and Nani Roma (KTM)
summary: The 2004 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its African era: 17 stage towns and bivouacs through France, Spain, Morocco, Mauritania, Mali, Burkina Faso, Senegal. Winners — Cars: Stéphane Peterhansel / Jean-Paul Cottret (Mitsubishi); Bikes: Nani Roma (KTM); Trucks: Vladimir Chagin / Semen Yakubov / Sergey Savostin (Kamaz).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
